tools.name: show_metronome
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a metronome, online metronome, 120 bpm metronome, tap tempo or a metronome for practice. Opens a live beat widget with 20 to 400 quarter-note BPM, 1 to 16 beats per bar, accents, subdivisions and an optional ramp with up to 1000 tempo stages. Reports milliseconds per bea

tools.name: calculate_tempo_values
tools.description: Use this when the user wants bpm to ms, a delay time calculator, tempo calculator, note cycle hertz, milliseconds to beats per minute, bar length or song length. Accepts BPM or a note duration and returns whole to sixty-fourth values, dotted and triplet, pre-delay suggestions and approximate Italian

tools.name: plan_tempo_practice
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a metronome for practice with a tempo ladder from start to target BPM, a BPM or percent step and minutes per stage. Returns the ladder table, total time and CSV download. Supports ascending or descending 20 to 400 BPM with up to 200 stages; percent steps round to 0.001 B
